newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: ICTSI Q1 net down at 43.9 mln pesos.
newsitem.headline: ICTSI Q1 net down at 43.9 mln pesos.

text.p: International Container Terminal Services Inc of the Philippines reported on Thursday its net income in the first quarter this year fell to 43.9 million pesos compared with 60.8 million in the year-earlier period.
The firm said the lower net in the first quarter was brought on by two one-time, non-recurring expense items.
Profit before extraordinary items was 119 million pesos in the first quarter, 22 percent higher over 97 million in the year-earlier period, ICTSI said.

One of the extraordinary costs involved financial restructuring expenses of 59 million pesos in relation to the exchange of $45.1 million worth of convertible notes it issued in September 1994 into new, lower interest convertible notes.
Another one-time expense amounted to 15 million pesos in relation to its streamlining programme.
ICTSI chairman Enrique Razon said the two extraordinary costs would benefit the company in the long term.

ICTSI, which is the sole operator of the Manila International Container Terminal, said revenues from local operations rose to 607 million pesos in the first quarter from 589 million as container traffice rose 2.7 percent to 204,529 twenty foot equivalent units (TEUs).
Its overseas operations swung to a net income of 37 million pesos in the first quarter from a loss of 19.7 million in the year-earlier quarter.
